answer.summary: All 30 DetectionRemediationApiTest errors and 22 JsonTypeDirtyOnLoadProbeTest errors come from one Spring context startup failure: a circular bean dependency (workflowService -> ... -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService). The PR touches NotificationEventService, WorkflowEndService and the notification handlers on that path, and the cycle is prohibited by default, so a rerun will fail the same way. Not a flake.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default.
